== Description ==

[[Benji Chu]] (left, navy #99 Judge T-shirt, black SWCCG cap, teal glasses, with his labeled deck box in the foreground) playing [[Amar Banger]] (right, grey T-shirt, dark hair bun, beard) at the stream table on Friday evening at the [[2025 World Championship]] in SeaTac, Washington, on 3 October 2025.
